purpose: Teach: 兵役/根絶/敵意/施政/余命/群集/沈下/借款

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、兵役経験者の戦後ストレスを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Ren, we're handling postwar stress from military service veterans as a medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady eye contact. Matter-of-fact tone without coldness. The slight pause before the main clause shows this is important information being carefully delivered.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、感染症の根絶を医療チームで目指します
lines.en: Yes, our medical team is working toward eradication of infectious disease.
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Measured pace. Warm but not effusive. The kind of calm that comes from genuine commitment rather than performance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療従事者への敵意を防ぐ取り組みを、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: I've noticed your hospital takes real care to prevent hostility toward medical staff, Doctor.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not flattery. Slight hesitation — Ren checking his own phrasing. Respectful but not deferential. Seeking confirmation more than asking permission.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、国の施政に基づいた医療制度を医療チームで運用します
lines.en: Yes, we implement our national health policy framework through coordinated team care.
lines.style: Steady continuance. Professional register maintained. A touch of quiet pride on 'implement.' Not rushed — each phrase lands with intentional weight.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 余命告知のあり方を、貴院、慎重に検討されてますね、先生
lines.en: It seems your hospital gives careful thought to how end-of-life information is shared, Doctor.
lines.style: Gentle observation, not interrogation. Ren's voice carries respect and genuine interest. Slight vulnerable quality — he's asking something that matters to him without quite saying why.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、群集事故時の救命を医療チームで訓練しております
lines.en: Yes, we conduct regular training for mass casualty rescue scenarios as a team.
lines.style: Measured, factual. Solid conviction on 'training.' No defensiveness — just stating what is. The tone of someone who takes preparedness seriously.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地盤沈下した病院の改築を、貴院、なさったんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital rebuilt after the structural subsidence, didn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Observational, almost wondering. Ren's voice carries admiration for the scale of undertaking. Soft, reflective — asking about something substantial and human-scaled.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、海外借款で導入した医療機器を医療チームで活用します
lines.en: Yes, we make full use of the medical equipment we brought in through overseas development loans.
lines.style: Composed and direct. Matter-of-fact tone without apology. The clinical warmth of someone explaining institutional choices. Slight finality at the close — the closing thought of a conversation.
